decisive_items: a solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass with ill-defined borders and a smooth mucosal surface
well-defined, hypoechoic lesion in the right cheek region
response.rationale: The mobile, smooth submucosal mass and well-defined hypoechoic ultrasound favor lipoma; severe pain is less typical but not exclusionary, while ectopic lymph node usually requires inflammatory context absent here.

rejected.why: No clear inflammatory or nodal features (e.g., tenderness or acute infection) support lymph node over lipoma; the clinical presentation aligns more with a benign soft-tissue tumor.
